title: A Radiators for the Postcards
author: Juniper Sandoval
blurb: Rafael Pemberton, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
